ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into potential Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including interviews with whistleblowers and analysis of financial records
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota's Medicaid system. By analyzing financial records and interviewing whistleblowers, we can shed light on the extent of the problem and hold those responsible accountable.
